items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: A fella we used to play for back there, they called Loi, Loi Bartamana, an Italian fella.

ctx.x: He put it in the cell.

He asked you what number you like, you know what I mean? And he put it on. And he had a little grocery store too. See, and he was making money here over here. See? Alright. He turns around. A fella we used to play for back there, they called Loi, Loi Bartamana, an Italian fella. Now you talk with a bad luck man. Now he was bad luck for. He had this place, he was running this place, we used to play for him. He couldn't do no best with that place. You know why? Because he was a fella who couldn't take nothing. You…
